# Spec: Hash, sign, compare and calculate

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/use-the-toolbox.md)

**Start:** `/utilities/toolbox`  
**Persona:** A developer checking integrity and similarity  
**Goal:** Hash some text, sign a message with a shared secret, measure how far apart two vectors are, evaluate an expression and get a one-time code.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Hash some text | A hash is shown. |
| 2 | Sign a message | A signature is shown. |
| 3 | Compare two vectors | All four distances are shown. |
| 4 | Calculate an expression | The result, optimized form and variable names are shown. |
| 5 | Get a one-time code | A code and an otpauth URI are shown. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `use-the-toolbox`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
